About

Lauren Kim is a multidisciplinary creative and textile designer specializing in ready-to-wear, activewear, and accessories. With expertise in printed, knit, and woven textiles, she balances hand-drawn and digital techniques to create distinctive, nuanced designs. With a keen eye and unique design sensibility, Lauren has partnered with global brands and emerging labels alike, delivering versatile, high-quality designs that highlight the beauty of print, color, and graphics. She is based in downtown, Manhattan.
